en: Nisa is staying with Kakek in the village. At night, Kakek switches off the porch light.
Nisa looks up. Wow! So many stars, twinkling everywhere.
'At home in the city I only see a few,' says Nisa. 'The bright city lights hide them,' says Kakek.
In the morning the sky is blue. 'Where did the stars go?' asks Nisa.
'They are still up there,' says Kakek. 'The sun is so bright that we cannot see them in the day.'
'And the sun is a star too,' says Kakek. 'It is our very own star, the closest one of all.'
id: Nisa menginap di rumah Kakek di desa. Malam hari, Kakek mematikan lampu teras.
Nisa memandang ke atas. Wah! Banyak sekali bintang berkelip di mana-mana.
'Di rumahku di kota, aku cuma melihat sedikit,' kata Nisa. 'Lampu kota yang terang menyembunyikannya,' kata Kakek.
Pagi harinya langit biru. 'Bintangnya ke mana?' tanya Nisa.
'Bintangnya masih di atas sana,' kata Kakek. 'Matahari sangat terang, jadi kita tidak bisa melihatnya di siang hari.'
'Matahari juga bintang,' kata Kakek. 'Itu bintang kita sendiri, yang paling dekat.'

readAloudNotes.en: Make a 'click' sound and dim the room light if you can.
readAloudNotes.id: Bersuara 'klik' dan redupkan lampu kamar jika bisa.

readAloudNotes.en: Open and close your fingers like twinkling stars.
Use a bright, excited voice for Nisa and a slow, kind voice for Kakek.
readAloudNotes.id: Pakai suara ceria untuk Nisa dan suara pelan dan lembut untuk Kakek.

readAloudNotes.en: Shrug your shoulders with a puzzled face.
Cover a twinkling hand with your other hand to show the stars being hidden.
readAloudNotes.id: Tutup tangan yang 'berkelip' dengan tangan lain untuk menunjukkan bintang tersembunyi.

readAloudNotes.en: Draw a big circle in the air with both arms for the sun.
readAloudNotes.id: Gambar lingkaran besar di udara dengan kedua tangan untuk matahari.

objectives.en: Listens to a story and recalls why stars are hard to see in the city and in the day.
objectives.id: Mendengarkan cerita dan mengingat mengapa bintang sulit terlihat di kota dan di siang hari.

objectives.en: Learns that the sun is a star.

meaning.en: shine with a light that seems to flicker
the covered space at the front of a house
a small place in the countryside

prompt.en: Why does Nisa see only a few stars in the city?
prompt.id: Mengapa Nisa hanya melihat sedikit bintang di kota?

en: the bright city lights hide them

prompt.en: Why did Kakek switch off the porch light?

en: so they could see the stars better
so the lamp could cool down for the cats

prompt.en: Where are the stars during the day?
prompt.id: Di mana bintang pada siang hari?

en: still in the sky, hidden by the sun's light
id: masih di langit, tertutup cahaya matahari

prompt.en: What does Kakek say the sun is?

connection.en: The sun is a star; other stars are still in the sky by day but the sun's light hides them.
connection.id: Matahari adalah bintang; bintang lain tetap ada di langit pada siang hari, tetapi tertutup cahaya matahari.

connection.en: Too much outdoor light at night (light pollution) hides the stars.
connection.id: Terlalu banyak lampu di luar pada malam hari (polusi cahaya) menyembunyikan bintang.

discussionPrompts.en: Have you ever seen lots of stars? Where were you?
discussionPrompts.id: Pernahkah kamu melihat banyak bintang? Di mana?

discussionPrompts.en: What other things are hard to see when it is very bright?
discussionPrompts.id: Benda apa lagi yang sulit terlihat saat sangat terang?

offlineActivity.en: In a dark room, shine a torch on the ceiling and look at the bright spot. Then switch on the big room light: the spot becomes hard to see, just like stars in the daytime. Never shine the torch into anyone's eyes.
offlineActivity.id: Di kamar yang gelap, sorotkan senter ke langit-langit dan lihat titik terangnya. Lalu nyalakan lampu kamar: titiknya jadi sulit terlihat, seperti bintang di siang hari. Jangan pernah menyorotkan senter ke mata siapa pun.

factChecks.claim: The sun is a star, and it is the closest star to Earth.
Stars are still in the sky during the day but the sun's brightness hides them.
Bright outdoor lights make fewer stars visible at night.

safetyNotes.en: Shine the torch only at walls or the ceiling, never into eyes. Stay with your child in the dark room.
safetyNotes.id: Sorotkan senter hanya ke dinding atau langit-langit, jangan ke mata. Temani anak di kamar yang gelap.
